checks.name: smoke_run_with_external_output_dir
checks.detail: Exit 0; all seven required artifacts were written outside the probe directory; summary.json kept contract_satisfied=false; all harness checks passed; per_sample.csv contained 54 data rows (3 executions x 18 heads).

checks.name: released_call_signature
checks.detail: The scoring call is model(False, text_tokens, video, device=device), matching the released ImageLatentsClassifier call form identified by review B1. No real inference was launched.

checks.name: released_package_import_path_and_provisioning
checks.detail: Real mode no longer runs pip inside its interpreter. After freezing the clone commit it inserts the two released project roots into sys.path, while requirements.txt preinstalls the verified import-time dependency set including matched torch 2.5.1/torchvision 0.20.1 and vector-quantize-pytorch 1.1.2. The import method and roots are recorded in provenance.json.

checks.name: dependency_failure_routing
checks.detail: Phase 1 fails with exit 11 when CUDA is absent or any declared dependency is unimportable, including non-ImportError ABI failures. Model and preprocessing import failures use exit 11. Tokenizer/text-encoder retrieval failures use exit 10. These are explicitly environment/access failures, not contract results.

checks.name: pinned_requirements
checks.detail: requirements.txt pins the driver plus verified released-code import dependencies, including a matched torch/torchvision pair, vector-quantize-pytorch 1.1.2, ema-pytorch, einops, beartype, accelerate, and eval.py dependencies. torch.load sets weights_only=False. Installation was not run locally because it is unnecessary for stdlib smoke mode and could be expensive.

checks.name: secondary_metrics_persisted
checks.detail: summary.json now records per-execution wall seconds; real-mode scoring additionally records peak GPU memory in GB for each execution. The smoke summary confirmed the schema.

checks.name: manifest_drift_gate
checks.detail: Real mode now stops with pair-validity exit 7 unless the deterministic filter reproduces the directly inspected Stage-0 count of 237 Br40f|Br60f pairs.

checks.name: scope_and_compute
checks.detail: Only review blockers B1-B5 were changed. No gated data, checkpoint, network download, CUDA inference, or expensive compute was launched.
